lines.text: How did a 1902 film send people to the Moon?
A Trip to the Moon, made in France by Georges Méliès.
Astronomers are fired from a giant cannon.
Their capsule lands in the Moon's eye.
They sleep on the surface, and a snowfall wakes them.
Moon creatures called Selenites capture them.
They escape, and the capsule falls back to Earth, into the ocean.
It is sometimes described as the first science fiction film.
Subscribe for the next film story.

description: A Trip to the Moon (1902), written, directed and produced by Georges Méliès, sends a group of astronomers to the Moon in a capsule fired from a giant cannon.
